REPORT
Date...August 13...1939.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No. REGISTRY No. S. B. D. 9502 (c)）
Subject...Z. VELICHINSKY - Suspected Japanese Agent.
Made by. D.P.S. Roberts Forwarded by. C. Crawford C.J.

Enquiries reveal that Z. VELICHINSKY, a Russian, arrived from Hongkong on June 6, 1939, together with his wife and until the date of his departure on the s.s. "Marechal Joffre" (1/7/39) resided at Cathay Mansions, before leaving VELICHINSKY requested the manager to forward all letters to 14 Village Road, Hongkong.

It was ascertained that during his stay in Shanghai, VELICHINSKY frequently received large sums of money rumoured to have been brought to him by a Chinese employed by the Japanese Naval Landing Party in Hongkew.

Although VELICHINSKY had made it known that he was in Shanghai for a holiday, it has been ascertained that he had quite a lot of deals with Japanese persons and bought several ponies for the purpose of transporting them to Hongkong where he is believed to be a horse-trainer in the employ of an influential Chinese.

During these transactions VELICHINSKY made the acquaintance of two Japanese, one of them being Mr. ISHIKAWA, employee of the Great Eastern Trading Company, 150 Kiukiang Road, who speaks Russian, the other is Mr. ISHINAGA or YOSHINAGA, both men reside at Room 6, 2 Quinsan Gardens.

Through the medium of these two men VELICHINSKY was introduced to a member of the Japanese Intelligence Office who asked him to act as an agent for Japan in Hongkong, later VELICHINSKY was provided with a question-

报告
日期……1939年8月13日……
（印：上海公共租界工部局 档案号 登记号 S. B. D. 9502 (c)）
事由……Z. VELICHINSKY - 疑似日本特工。
制作人：D.P.S. Roberts 转呈人：C. Crawford C.J.

经查，俄国人 Z. VELICHINSKY 于1939年6月6日与其妻子一同从香港抵达上海，直至其于1939年7月1日乘“马雷夏尔·若夫雷”号（s.s. "Marechal Joffre"）离境前，一直居住于国泰公寓（Cathay Mansions）。在离开之前，VELICHINSKY 要求经理将所有信件转寄至香港乡村道14号（14 Village Road, Hongkong）。

据查，VELICHINSKY 在上海逗留期间，经常收到大笔款项，传闻这些钱是由一名受雇于虹口日本海军陆战队的中国人带给他的。

尽管 VELICHINSKY 声称来上海是为了度假，但经查实，他与日本人进行了不少交易，并购买了几匹小马，目的是将它们运往香港。据信他在香港受雇于一位有影响力的中国人，担任驯马师。

在这些交易过程中，VELICHINSKY 结识了两名日本人，其中一位是 ISHIKAWA 先生，他是九江路150号大东贸易公司（Great Eastern Trading Company）的雇员，会说俄语；另一位是 ISHINAGA 或 YOSHINAGA 先生，这两人均居住在昆山路花园2号6室（Room 6, 2 Quinsan Gardens）。

通过这两人的介绍，VELICHINSKY 结识了日本情报机构的一名成员，该成员要求他作为日本在香港的特工行事。随后，VELICHINSKY 得到了一份用俄文写成的问——

（左侧批注：FILE 82/1）

Discreet enquiries made among Russian employees
at the Race-course elicited that another horse dealer
Aron PREJINSKY, 240 Route Tenant de la Tour, who had
at some time previous to VELICHINSKY's arrival in
Shanghai negotiated with the Japanese for the purpose
of buying horses, had been arrested by Japanese Military
Authorities and detained for a period of six or seven
days during which time he was repeatedly asked whether
he knew a Mr. VELICHINSKY who was a horse dealer in
Hongkong. Mr. PREJINSKY was later interviewed and
stated that such was the case and that he had been
informed that a Dr. KAHN, a friend of VELICHINSKY, had
at sometime been arrested by Chinese Military Authorities
but had been released, when asked whether this information
was from a reliable source or if he had any means of
substantiating it, he replied that he had not, that it
was only what he had heard.

Owing to the fact that VELICHINSKY's stay in
Shanghai was so short, and that enquiries respecting his
two associates so difficult, no further information is
available.

向赛马场的俄国雇员进行谨慎查询后得知，另一名马商 Aron PREJINSKY，住址为陶尔斐司路240号（240 Route Tenant de la Tour），曾在 VELICHINSKY 抵达上海之前的一段时间内与日本人洽谈购马事宜，他被日本军方当局逮捕并拘留了六七天。在此期间，他反复被询问是否认识一位名叫 VELICHINSKY 的马商，此人据称在香港从事马匹交易。后来对 PREJINSKY 先生进行了问询，他证实了此事，并称获悉 VELICHINSKY 的朋友 KAHN 博士曾在某个时候被中国军方当局逮捕，但随后获释。当被问及该信息是否来自可靠来源或他是否有办法证实时，他回答说没有，这只是他听到的消息。

由于 VELICHINSKY 在上海停留时间很短，且对其两名同伙的调查十分困难，故无更多情报可供提供。

E.
B.m.

L J Roberts

Subject : Information on Z. VELITCHINSKY

Coming from Hongkong with his wife,
Z. VELITCHINSKY, Russian emigrant aged 29, arrived
in Shanghai on June 6. He resided at Room 910,
Cathay Mansions.

VELITCHINSKY, a horse dealer, came to
Shanghai to purchase colts for the Hongkong Race
Course. He returned to the Colony on August 1,
1939 in the s.s. "Marechal Joffre."

According to information from a foreign source,
VELITCHINSKY, during the course of his stay in Shanghai,
contacted one of the Japanese Intelligence Offices and
was given a job of work to do in Hongkong.

He contacted this Intelligence Office through
the medium of two Japanese. One of them, ISHIKAWA,
speaks Russian; he is employed with the Great Eastern
Trading Company, 150 Kiukiang Road. The other man is
ISHINAGA. Both of them reside at Room 6, 2 Quinsan
Gardens.

VELITCHINSKY made the acquaintance of these
people over a deal concerning the purchase of horses.

During the course of this affair, another
merchant, Aron PREJINSKY, 240 Route Tenant de la Tour,
who furnished VELITCHINSKY with horses, was arrested
by the Japanese, who accused him of espionage. The
arrest was made at the instigation of VELITCHINSKY.
PREJINSKY was released six days later as the result
of intervention on the part of the French Police.

FILE

事由：关于 Z. VELITCHINSKY 的情报

Z. VELITCHINSKY，29岁，俄国流亡者，与其妻子一同从香港出发，于6月6日抵达上海。他居住在国泰公寓910室。

VELITCHINSKY 是一名马商，来上海是为了给香港赛马会购买小马驹。他于1939年8月1日乘“马雷夏尔·若夫雷”号轮船返回该殖民地。

根据来自外籍人士的情报，VELITCHINSKY 在上海逗留期间，接触了日本情报机构之一，并受命在香港执行一项任务。

他是通过两名日本人与该情报机构取得联系的。其中一人 ISHIKAWA 会说俄语；他就职于九江路150号的大东贸易公司（Great Eastern Trading Company）。另一人名叫 ISHINAGA。两人均居住在昆山路花园2号6室。

VELITCHINSKY 是在一笔马匹买卖交易中结识这些人的。

在此事过程中，另一名向 VELITCHINSKY 提供马匹的商人 Aron PREJINSKY，住址为陶尔斐司路240号，被日本人逮捕，日本人指控其从事间谍活动。此次逮捕据称是在 VELITCHINSKY 的唆使下进行的。PREJINSKY 在法国警方干预后，于六天后获释。

档案
上海特别支部。
C. 13.
